title: feat(app-shell): studio dogfood follow-ups — API-name derive, read-only gating, publish confirm, nav scaffold, i18n sweep
body:
## What

Implements all five console-side findings from the Studio package-create UX dogfood (objectstack-ai/framework#2615, audit `docs/audits/2026-07-studio-package-create-ux-dogfood.md`):

Closes #2259, closes #2260, closes #2261, closes #2262, closes #2264.

- **#2260 — field API name derives from the label for generic auto names.** `maybeDeriveName` only recognised type-based auto names (`text_2`, `status`); the Data pillar's "+ Add field" produces `field_N`, so relabeling never derived and records kept `field_N` data columns forever. Both shapes now derive; custom names, CJK-only labels, and sibling collisions unchanged. +5 unit tests.
- **#2259 — read-only packages gate authoring client-side (ADR-0057 D10 courtesy gate).** `StudioDesignSurface` resolves the package's writability once and passes `readOnly` to all four pillars: Add field, New object/flow/permission set, nav Edit, Save draft, Publish and Create app hide or disable with a `readonlyHint` tooltip; the field inspector opens read-only; records stay fully usable; the server ADR-0070 gate remains the authority (unknown writability stays ungated).
- **#2261 — publish is review-then-confirm.** The header Publish button opens `DraftChangesPanel`; its new footer button ("Publish N change(s)") fires the atomic publish. Panel entries now expand to a lazy per-item diff: object fields added/removed/changed plus changed top-level properties vs the live version.
- **#2262 — create-app scaffolds navigation from the package's objects** (checkbox, default on): `buildAppSkeleton` seeds one `type: 'object'` nav item per object — the missing `type` discriminator was caught by the `createConformance` spec gate on the first attempt, which is exactly what that gate is for. Conformance case added for the nav-seeded skeleton.
- **#2264 — studio-design's hardcoded Chinese now routes through i18n.** BuilderLanding / ObjectFormDesigner / ObjectValidationsPanel / ObjectSettingsPanel rendered hardcoded Chinese regardless of locale (the mixed-language screens from the dogfood, and an English-only-codebase violation). All user-visible strings resolve via `t()`/`tFormat()` with English defaults + zh-CN translations (58 keys added under `engine.studio.landing/designer/rules/settings`, existing keys reused).

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` clean; full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite **1044/1044** green (3 assertions updated to the new en-US defaults).
- Browser-verified end-to-end against a live framework showcase backend (HMR console → seeded admin):
  - read-only `com.example.showcase`: Add field / New object gone, Publish disabled, Read-only badge intact, records grid still works;
  - writable package: new field `field_3` → label "Priority" → API name becomes `priority` on blur;
  - Publish opens the panel; entry expands to `+ field priority`; footer publish succeeds with the existing toast;
  - fresh package: Create app with the scaffold checkbox produces a draft app whose `navigation` carries the object item, `_diagnostics.valid: true`;
  - Studio landing renders fully in English (and zh-CN via the locale switch path).
- Changeset included (`@object-ui/app-shell`: minor). Pre-existing `react-hooks/static-components` eslint error in `ObjectSettingsPanel` is on `main` unchanged (out of scope).
